setup_help: 请填写昵称、预约称呼及联系方式，方便店主认出你、核对预约。头像和微信号由你主动提供，可以稍后补充。
Add your display name, booking name and contact details so the host can recognise you and match your booking. You choose your avatar and provide your WeChat ID; these can be added later.
wechat_id_placeholder: 填写可添加好友的微信号
Your WeChat ID for adding contacts
wechat_id_help: 由你填写，用于店主联系和核对预约；微信登录不会自动提供微信号。
Provided by you so the host can contact you and match your booking. WeChat sign-in does not supply your WeChat ID.
wechat_id_invalid: 请检查微信号，可使用字母、数字、下划线、短横线或点号。
Check your WeChat ID. Use letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens or dots.
image_help: JPG、PNG 或 WebP，最大 2 MB。图片会居中裁成正方形。
JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB. The image is cropped to a square from the centre.
nickname_help: 1–20 characters. You can change this anytime.
shared_help: 昵称和头像与拼豆图纸生成器共用。邮箱仍用于登录。
Your display name and avatar are shared with the pattern maker. You still sign in with your email.
name_invalid: 请输入 1–20 个字符的昵称。
Enter a display name of 1–20 characters.
name_rejected: 这个昵称无法使用，请换一个。
This display name cannot be used. Please choose another.
image_invalid: 请选择 JPG、PNG 或 WebP 图片。
Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
image_large: The image must be no larger than 2 MB.
save_error: 资料未确认保存，请重试。
We could not confirm the changes. Please try again.
avatar_error: 头像未确认保存，请重试或换一张图片。
We could not confirm the avatar change. Please retry or choose another image.
partial_save: 昵称已保存；头像未确认保存，请重试。
Your display name was saved. The avatar change was not confirmed; please retry.
wechat_profile_help: 微信可用于登录。店主看到的是你主动保存的昵称、头像和联系方式；微信号不会自动读取。
WeChat can be used to sign in. The host sees the display name, avatar and contact details you save. Your WeChat ID is not read automatically.
mobile_link_help: 请在电脑上登录此账号，再用手机微信扫码完成绑定。
Sign in to this account on a computer, then scan the code with WeChat on your phone to link it.
